## Description

Primary source:

<https://ngs101.com/how-to-analyze-single-cell-rna-seq-data-complete-beginners-guide-part-4-cell-type-identification/>

Part 3 of 3. The four annotations from parts 1-2 (manual, SingleR, scType,
scCATCH) are compared by confusion matrix, alluvial (Sankey-style) plot and
side-by-side UMAP. A cluster-level table is exported for manual review; a
consensus label is added by hand and imported to produce the final annotation.

Rule of thumb used in the article for the manual review: 4/4 methods agree ->
accept; 3/4 -> usually accept after checking markers; 2/4 -> investigate;
no agreement -> manual review.

## Libraries and directories

```{r step1_libs_data}

# Core single-cell analysis
library(Seurat)              # Main scRNA-seq toolkit
library(SeuratObject)        # Seurat object infrastructure

# Visualization and data manipulation
library(ggplot2)             # Custom plots when needed
library(ggalluvial)          # Alluvial / Sankey plots
library(patchwork)           # Combine plots
library(dplyr)               # Data manipulation
library(scales)              # Plot scales
library(viridis)             # Color palettes

if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  # Running interactively (e.g. via "Run Cell") rather than through
  # knit/render, so `params` was never created by rmarkdown::render().
  # Reconstruct it by parsing this .Rmd's own YAML header, so the params
  # defaults live in exactly one place (the YAML block above) instead of
  # being duplicated here.
  rmd_path <- tryCatch(
    # Only reliable when this document is the active editor tab; if focus
    # has moved to another file, this will pick up the wrong path.
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path,
    error = function(e) NA_character_
  )
  if (is.na(rmd_path) || !nzchar(rmd_path)) {
    # Fallback if rstudioapi is unavailable or no doc is focused; assumes
    # the working directory is the project root.
    rmd_path <- "scRNAseq_tutorial_4_cell_type_annotation/tut4_cell_type_annotation_part3.Rmd"
  }
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(rmd_path)$params
}

# Set working directory
base.dir <- params$base.dir
annot.dir <- file.path(base.dir, params$annot.subdir)

# Create output directories
for (d in c("plots/method_comparison", "annotations")) {
  if (!dir.exists(file.path(annot.dir, d))) dir.create(file.path(annot.dir, d), recursive = TRUE)
}

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(params$seed)

# Configure plotting defaults
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

cluster.col <- params$cluster.col

# Files from part 2 and final outputs
annotated_part2.file <- "integrated_automated_annotated_seurat.rds"
annotated_final.file <- "integrated_annotated_seurat.rds"
consensus.file <- file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", "cluster_level_comparison.csv")
```

## Load object from part 2

```{r step2_load_obj}
integrated_seurat <- readRDS(file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", annotated_part2.file))
load(file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", "annot_part1.RData")) # umap_reduction

methods <- c(Manual = "manual_annotation", SingleR = "singler_annotation",
             scType = "sctype_annotation", scCATCH = "sccatch_annotation")
stopifnot(all(methods %in% colnames(integrated_seurat@meta.data)))
Idents(integrated_seurat) <- cluster.col
```

## Confusion matrices

Cell-level cross-tabulation of each automated method against the manual
annotation.

```{r step3_confusion}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 10: Confusion matrices vs. manual annotation
#-----------------------------------------------

# The article's version of this helper is truncated on the page; completed here
create_confusion_matrix <- function(obj, method1, method2) {
  table(Method1 = obj@meta.data[[method1]],
        Method2 = obj@meta.data[[method2]])
}

auto_methods <- methods[names(methods) != "Manual"]
confusion_list <- lapply(auto_methods, function(m) {
  create_confusion_matrix(integrated_seurat, methods[["Manual"]], m)
})

for (nm in names(confusion_list)) {
  cat("\n=== Manual (rows) vs.", nm, "(columns) ===\n")
  print(confusion_list[[nm]])
  write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(confusion_list[[nm]]),
            file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", paste0("confusion_manual_vs_", nm, ".csv")))
}
```

## Alluvial (Sankey) diagrams

```{r step4_sankey, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 11: Alluvial plots
#-----------------------------------------------

prepare_sankey_data <- function(obj, method1, method2) {
  obj@meta.data %>%
    transmute(Method1 = .data[[method1]], Method2 = .data[[method2]]) %>%
    count(Method1, Method2, name = "n_cells")
}

create_sankey_plot <- function(df, label1, label2) {
  ggplot(df, aes(axis1 = Method1, axis2 = Method2, y = n_cells)) +
    geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Method1), width = params$sankey.width, alpha = params$sankey.alpha) +
    geom_stratum(width = params$sankey.width, fill = "grey90", color = "grey40") +
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c(label1, label2), expand = c(0.15, 0.05)) +
    labs(y = "Cells", title = paste(label1, "vs.", label2)) +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

for (nm in names(auto_methods)) {
  df <- prepare_sankey_data(integrated_seurat, methods[["Manual"]], auto_methods[[nm]])
  p <- create_sankey_plot(df, "Manual", nm)
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/method_comparison", paste0("sankey_manual_vs_", nm, ".png")),
         p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
}
```

## Side-by-side UMAP

```{r step5_umap_compare, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 14}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 12: Four-panel UMAP
#-----------------------------------------------

umap_panels <- lapply(names(methods), function(nm) {
  DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = umap_reduction, group.by = methods[[nm]],
          label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, label.size = 3, pt.size = 0.1) +
    ggtitle(nm)
})
p_compare <- (umap_panels[[1]] | umap_panels[[2]]) / (umap_panels[[3]] | umap_panels[[4]])
print(p_compare)
ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/method_comparison/umap_method_comparison.png"),
       p_compare, width = 18, height = 14, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
```

## Build consensus annotations

### Step 1: Export for manual review

```{r step6_export}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 13: Export cell-level and cluster-level comparison tables
#-----------------------------------------------

meta <- integrated_seurat@meta.data
keep.cols <- c(params$sample.col, params$condition.col)

annotation_comparison <- data.frame(
  cell_barcode = colnames(integrated_seurat),
  cluster = meta[[cluster.col]],
  manual = meta[[methods[["Manual"]]]],
  singler = meta[[methods[["SingleR"]]]],
  sctype = meta[[methods[["scType"]]]],
  sccatch = meta[[methods[["scCATCH"]]]],
  meta[, keep.cols, drop = FALSE]
)
write.csv(annotation_comparison,
          file.path(annot.dir, "annotations/all_methods_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Most frequent label per method within each cluster
mode_label <- function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]

cluster_summary <- annotation_comparison %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(),
            manual = mode_label(manual),
            singler = mode_label(singler),
            sctype = mode_label(sctype),
            sccatch = mode_label(sccatch),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(as.character(cluster)))

# Empty column to be filled in by hand
cluster_summary$consensus_annotation <- NA_character_

write.csv(cluster_summary, consensus.file, row.names = FALSE)
print(as.data.frame(cluster_summary), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Step 2: Manual comparison

Open `annotations/cluster_level_comparison.csv` (path in `consensus.file` above),
and fill the `consensus_annotation` column for each cluster, using method
agreement together with the marker evidence from part 1. Save the CSV, then run
the remaining chunks. They are skipped while the column is empty.

### Step 3: Import consensus and finalize

```{r step7_import, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 14: Import consensus labels
#-----------------------------------------------

cluster_consensus <- read.csv(consensus.file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
have_consensus <- any(!is.na(cluster_consensus$consensus_annotation) &
                        nzchar(cluster_consensus$consensus_annotation))

if (have_consensus) {
  cluster_to_consensus <- setNames(cluster_consensus$consensus_annotation, cluster_consensus$cluster)
  integrated_seurat$final_annotation <-
    unname(cluster_to_consensus[as.character(integrated_seurat@meta.data[[cluster.col]])])

  if (anyNA(integrated_seurat$final_annotation)) {
    warning("Some clusters have no consensus label: ",
            paste(unique(integrated_seurat@meta.data[[cluster.col]][is.na(integrated_seurat$final_annotation)]),
                  collapse = ", "))
  }
  print(table(integrated_seurat$final_annotation, useNA = "ifany"))

  p_final <- DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = umap_reduction, group.by = "final_annotation",
                     label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 0.1) + ggtitle("Final consensus annotation")
  print(p_final)
  ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/method_comparison/umap_final_annotation.png"),
         p_final, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
} else {
  message("consensus_annotation is empty in ", consensus.file, "; fill it in and re-run from this chunk.")
}
```

```{r step8_split_condition, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 7, eval = have_consensus}
p_final_split <- DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = umap_reduction, group.by = "final_annotation",
                         split.by = params$condition.col, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 0.1)
print(p_final_split)
ggsave(file.path(annot.dir, "plots/method_comparison/umap_final_annotation_by_condition.png"),
       p_final_split, width = 18, height = 7, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
```

## Save annotated data

```{r step9_save, eval = have_consensus}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 15: Save final object and metadata
#-----------------------------------------------

saveRDS(integrated_seurat, file.path(annot.dir, "annotations", annotated_final.file))

meta.cols <- c(params$sample.col, params$condition.col, params$patient.col, cluster.col,
               unname(methods), "final_annotation")
meta.cols <- meta.cols[nzchar(meta.cols) & meta.cols %in% colnames(integrated_seurat@meta.data)]

write.csv(integrated_seurat@meta.data[, meta.cols, drop = FALSE],
          file.path(annot.dir, "annotations/cell_metadata_final.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
```
